mintAuthority.summary: Frankencoin remains economically unbounded, but every new arbitrary issuer faces an unavoidable 14-day public window and a 200-bps holding-period-weighted FPS veto. The closed pinned native caller inventory proves collateral/limit-gated issuance, atomically repaid flash minting and D30-S formula-bound, hard-rate-capped interest with minority-replaceable seven-day rate changes. Distressed Equity restructuring is asymmetric, but the pin's healthy equity makes it unreachable; D30-R conditionally excludes the dependent zero-supply bootstrap. All D30/Amendments A–B gates are positively certified at the pin, including these owner-ruled monetary-policy and insolvency exceptions; bridge routes remain a separate lane.

controls.label: Frankencoin minter registry
controls.capDescription: suggestMinter(address,uint256,uint256,string) requires an application period >=1209600 seconds, fee >=1000e18 ZCHF and an unregistered address, collects the fee, records timestamp+period and emits MinterApplied. isMinter activates at timestamp equality unless denyMinter deletes registration. mint, mintWithReserve and coverLoss impose only minterOnly (direct registration or a registered position whose parent is active), not economic collateral or a durable aggregate cap; registerPosition has no position-code check or independent veto. Existing native caller restrictions are separately certified. The bootstrap initialize requires both ZCHF and FPS supply zero; pinned supplies are nonzero, but there is no one-time latch, so this is disabled-reactivatable after complete wind-down, not disabled-final. CCIP-only machinery is inventoried in the research note and stays in the separate Bridge Risk lane.

restructure.evidence: Ethereum block 26113561 (0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e, 2026-10-03T18:19:11Z): eth_call Frankencoin.equity()=3621269413393034879313612 wei, or3621269.413393034879313612 ZCHF, above both the 1000-ZCHF code threshold and the M3 certification guard of 2000 ZCHF (2 times that threshold). Verified restructureCapTable requires zchf.equity()<1000e18 and checkQualified before burning arbitrary FPS balances. A pinned healthy-state restructuring eth_call reverts. The deployed Equity ABI/inherited ERC20 exposes no public FPS burn; its only FPS supply-reducing entrypoints are redemption and restructuring. calculateProceeds used by every redeem variant requires shares+1e18<totalSupply, leaving strictly more than one FPS; transfers (including transfers to dead addresses) do not reduce supply and zero-address transfers revert. kamikaze only changes vote anchors. Therefore only restructuring can reduce this positive FPS supply to zero; initialize requires both FPS and ZCHF supply zero and is disabled-reactivatable only after restructuring and total ZCHF wind-down. D30-R excludes that dependent path while the pinned equity condition is unreachable, not permanently.
